text_block_list.text:
While I was putting together the training 
materials—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, up until now, most of my fans thought 
of me as "cute," right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, what do you think was written in 
the fan letter I got today!?”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Teio-san was faster and cooler than 
anyone else when she ran on the turf!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If I keep running my heart out just 
like this—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Someday, everyone will look at me and say 
I'm cool, just like the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, from here on out, I'll keep 
charging ahead as the cool and invincible 
Lord Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's the Prez walking outside! I 
was wondering where she went, and there 
she is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go over to the Prez's place! 
Well then, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, I'm gonna show my fan letters 
to the Prez and get praised too~♪"

Though Tokai Teio has grown a little, it 
seems it will still be a while before she 
can wean herself off the Prez.
